anomalies.observed: The 120 Ω termination resistors are wired through the 2-bit DIP switch SW6 in a crossed manner: R34 connects /CAN0_N to SW6 pin 1, while SW6 pin 3 is /CAN1_P; R35 connects /CAN1_N to SW6 pin 2, while SW6 pin 4 is /CAN0_P. With the same pin convention used by SW7 (pins 1-4 are one switch side and pins 5-8 are the other), closing SW6 connects CAN0_N to CAN1_P and CAN1_N to CAN0_P.
anomalies.expected: Each termination resistor should switch across its own CAN bus: R34 between /CAN0_P and /CAN0_N, and R35 between /CAN1_P and /CAN1_N, preserving the separate/isolated CAN0 and CAN1 buses described in the specification.
anomalies.impact: When the termination switches are enabled, the two CAN buses are cross-coupled and effectively bridged, causing CAN communication failures and defeating the intended isolation/separation of CAN0 and CAN1.
